result.summary: The screen is visually well-structured with no major defects; only minor content and styling inconsistencies were observed.

issues.description: Inconsistent dash usage in delivery time badges ('15–25 min' uses an en-dash while '20-30 min' uses a hyphen).
issues.suggestion: Standardize to a single dash style across all time estimates.

issues.description: Redundant delivery fee information on Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, displaying '€0 delivery' both as an image badge and in the metadata line.
issues.suggestion: Omit the redundant metadata text when the promotional badge is present.
